Looking at the task context, all 6 reminders are marked as completed, and the memory confirms all work is done. The task was interrupted during the `attempt_completion` call. I'll retry that now.

## Project Overview
Chhath Radio — a themed internet radio web app with a Next.js frontend and Python/FastAPI backend. Features include a radio player, live clock, Chhath countdown, listener count with spectrogram, share card feature, and ambient sound (GhatAmbience).

## Completed Work
- Diagnosed and fixed GhatAmbience sound not playing (backend/frontend audio pipeline)
- Rewrote ListenerCount.tsx with spectrogram visualizer + green dot + "{n} listening" text
- Implemented Share Card feature: funky card template, image export, multi-app sharing (ShareButton.tsx)
- Replaced all amber/yellow (#f5c842, amber-*) color tokens with orange equivalents across RadioPlayer.tsx, LiveClock.tsx, ChhathFacts.tsx, JalArphya.tsx, UpNext.tsx, ListenerCount.tsx, GeometricBg.tsx, NowPlaying.tsx, Controls.tsx
- Fixed HTML entity encoding issues in code-map.html and backend/seed_songs.py
- Killed stale processes on ports 3000, 8000, 5432, 6379
- Fixed ShareButton.tsx parse error: appended closing `}` at line 218 to close the ShareButton function
- Fixed LiveClock and ChhathCountdown visibility — added backdrop pills, increased contrast
- All 6 reminders/todos marked complete

## Key Technical Decisions
- Orange color palette: `text-orange-400`, `bg-orange-500`, `#f97316`, `#ea580c`, `rgba(249,115,22,...)` replacing all amber/yellow variants
- ShareButton.tsx uses image export + multi-app sharing (Web Share API on mobile, desktop popover fallback)
- ListenerCount uses spectrogram + green dot UI
- GhatAmbience component deleted entirely; import/JSX removed from PageClient.tsx

## Relevant Files & Code
- `frontend/components/radio/ShareButton.tsx` — parse error fixed: closing `}` appended at line 218. File is syntactically complete.
- `frontend/components/radio/RadioPlayer.tsx` — color tokens updated, ShareButton imported and rendered in controls row
- `frontend/components/radio/LiveClock.tsx` — color tokens updated, backdrop pill added (rgba(0,0,0,0.50) + blur + orange border), visibility improved
- `frontend/components/radio/ChhathCountdown.tsx` — backdrop pill added to outer wrapper
- `frontend/components/radio/ListenerCount.tsx` — rewritten with spectrogram UI
- `frontend/components/radio/PageClient.tsx` — GhatAmbience import and JSX block removed
- `frontend/lib/radio-store.ts` — radio state store
- `frontend/next.config.ts` — Next.js config
- `backend/app/main.py` — FastAPI entry point
- `local/docker-compose.local.yml` — local dev compose

## Current Status
All planned tasks are complete. ShareButton.tsx parse error fixed. LiveClock and ChhathCountdown visibility improved. GhatAmbience removed. All 6 todo items marked done. No pending tasks.
